remarks: 19 Edgerton Street in Darien, Connecticut, is a charming Cape Cod-style home situated in the desirable Noroton Heights neighborhood. Built in 1949, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence offers 2,083 square feet of living space on a 0.25-acre lot. This home features a large living room with wood burning fireplace, a spacious eat-in kitchen, and abundant natural light throughout. A rear deck is accessible from the kitchen and family room, providing a perfect space for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. There is also a large basement with ample storage. The interior has been recently painted, enhancing its bright and inviting atmosphere. The property is conveniently located within walking distance to the Noroton Heights Metro-North train station, schools, and shopping areas.
